title: Chapter 1057
paragraphs: Chapter 1057
Episode 251: The Great Adversaries (7)
Jin naturally planned to visit Silkiya in the Demon World, but instead, she called him to the kingdom of Mila.
"It's good to see you both. I was surprised to receive your message."
"Finding peace is not easy. There are even worse beings than Zito in each dimension."
As soon as they entered, Misol and Tiliath greeted Jin and Syris.

"Welcome, Savior of the Demon World, Descendant of the Ice Castle. I should have gone to the Tikan Palace, but currently, my powers don't feel strenuous when used specifically towards this world, which is why I've inconvenienced you."
Silkiya Arcia, the leader of the Bisects.
She respectfully bowed to Jin, whom she was meeting after a long time.
"Please don't do this, Lady Silkiya. It's burdensome. I was going to go to the Demon World directly, but thanks to you, I can meet you comfortably here. Has using your abilities become easier now?"

Originally, Silkiya used her dimension-traveling powers very restrictively. During the Great Demon War, even when Basset was injured, he prevented Silkiya from using her powers. But now, she had opened a path from the Demon World to the world just to meet Jin.
"I have something to tell you related to that. It seems to be connected to the information we recently received."
The information referred to, of course, was the truth of the world told by Orgal.
".....Related, you said?"
"Yes, not long after I received what Orgal had told you... I started recalling events that I had never experienced, as if I had."
Jin's eyes widened. Silkiya was experiencing something similar to his colleagues who had seen 'another self' in the Abyss Legion.
"Please tell me more."
The 'memories of another world' that Silkiya recalled were these.

"Firstly, in another world, I was used by a group called Zipple. They used my abilities to interfere with other dimensions. I couldn't resist because they took people from the Demon World hostage, like Zito."
Jin's reason for wanting to meet Silkiya as soon as he realized the world's truth was perhaps that her powers might be a key to combating Zipple across multiple worlds.
Indeed, Silkiya's abilities had the potential to transcend dimensions. It was just that Zipple from other dimensions had used them before Jin.
"...Even in worlds where Zito hadn't resurrected, the Demon World was trampled by Zipple."
"It's hard to accept. Neither you nor Silkiya would lie."
"According to Silkiya's new memories, it's the first time the Demon World has been saved in this world. In all other dimensions, it wasn't."

"I can't clearly remember how I opened the portals between dimensions yet. But maybe with more time, it will come to me. Then I will use that power, not for Zipple but for the Alliance and the safety of the world."
Silkiya spent some time detailing the memories of the multiverse. Like Orgal, it seemed painful for her to recall, as she frequently stopped to catch her breath.
There were a total of five worlds in her memory.
In all five dimensions, Silkiya was a slave to Zipple and a key figure for dimensional interference.
"But unlike the others who saw their other selves through the Abyss Legion, Lady Silkiya recalled the multiverse memories without it."
Syris noted.
Until now, Helluram was the only one who had faced the memories of the multiverse without the Abyss Legion.

"Lady Syris, the Demon Army uses all dimensional interference through the portals I created. Recently, the portal in this world was used, and my powers reacted to it. I suspect that's why this phenomenon occurred."
If something stimulates the 'interdimensional portals' used by the Demon Army, the same power in this world responds.

Jin and Syris felt that Silkiya's speculation was likely correct. Recently, Zipple had been receiving support from other dimensions, so the portals created by Silkiya in other worlds must have been used.
Although it was a painful truth that the Demon Army first exploited Silkiya, and the multiverse memories must have been overwhelming for her personally.
Jin felt like he had discovered an unexpected strategy.
"Lady Silkiya, you said that with time, you might recall how to open the portals between dimensions?"
"Yes, Jin."
"Then, could it also be possible to close them?"
Closing the portals. If that could be done, Zipple would fundamentally be unable to receive support from other dimensions.
Of course, there are more than five Silkiyas in other dimensions, so it might be easier for them to open new doors than for this Silkiya to close them.
But it was worth trying. Even if it only disrupted Zipple's support at a critical moment, it would be a great help.

"I've been considering that, Jin. The Silkiya of other worlds are exhausted and in a wretched state, their life and death uncertain. I haven't felt the memory of death yet, but it's definitely not a normal situation. I should be able to handle it alone once I'm fully awakened."

Fighting against the versions of herself in other terrible situations, Silkiya spoke calmly. For her, only this world mattered. The Demon Worlds in other dimensions were already irreversibly under Zipple's brainwashing and tyranny.
"My bigger concern is if Zipple has reached a stage where they can reproduce my abilities with only an origin stone. If that's the case, it would be difficult for me to close the portals on my own."
Without trying, they wouldn't know. For now, they had to wait until Silkiya regained enough power.
"It must be hard, thank you for your strength, Lady Silkiya."
"It's nothing. I will do whatever I can. This place, where our demon kind finally gained freedom... I want to protect it. I must."
"Don't cry, Silkiya. It's okay."
"That's right, Silkiya. Jin has saved our Demon World, and now, thanks to you, we can help the Alliance. We can repay our debt. It will be fine."
Misol and Tiliath comforted Silkiya. She stopped crying and looked at Jin and Syris.
"...I'm embarrassed by my emotional display. Please forget it. Now, let's talk about the Altar of the Sun God."
The Altar of the Sun God, somewhere in the Demon World. Silkiya already knew about the nature of the Sun God, thanks to the memories of the multiverse.

"The identity held by the dormant Kinzelo at that altar is Fokal, a self that desires the maintenance of the world. Zipple once used him as material for an origin stone. When he awakens, he will be a strong ally for the Alliance."
This was information unknown even to Orgal. Misol, on Silkiya's behalf, proudly boasted.
"Isn't Silkiya the best? The method to block interdimensional interference and information about the Sun God Fokal, where else could you hear such things all at once?"

The more allies against Zipple and the Demon Army, the better. Especially transcendent beings like the self of the Sun God. They could be a significant variable, beyond mere force, just by their divine nature.
Especially now that 'Bligiet' was suspected of collaborating with Zipple, having an entity like Fokal on their side could help balance the scales.
"Yeah, you're the best, Misol. Lady Silkiya, do you also know the exact location of the Altar of the Sun God?"
"I do. But don't send precious personnel from the Alliance to the Demon World. It's a place only accessible through my powers. Instead, just leave the sword you brought today."
Before meeting Jin, Silkiya had requested a particular sword from Tikan.
The Sun Sword Tetalon, a weapon of the Red Plutonian’s Shimat, forged from the physical essence of the Sun God.
During the final stages of the Lafrarosa Liberation War, Shimat discarded this sword and, with a crimson thunderbolt, forged a new one to confront Luna.
Thanks to that, Tetalon was in perfect condition and secured by the Alliance.

"That sword was the key to unlocking Fokal's altar. Ironic, isn't it? The Red Plutonian always wished for change, yet their god wielded a sword made from the body of Fokal, who desires the world's natural maintenance."
Jin handed over the Tetalon he had brought to Tiliath.
The Demon World's role within the Alliance became clear. Centered around Silkiya, their task was to block interdimensional interference and resurrect Fokal.
"It must be a heavy burden, Lady Silkiya."
"I'm used to fighting for freedom, for salvation. Please, lead us to victory once more, Lord Jin."
"Silkiya just made Jin's shoulders heavy after saying that, they'd be more heavy."
"It seems like our meeting is over. Jin, how are the members of the Alliance on the surface? I'd like to meet the liberated Plutonian sometime."
They spent the next hour catching up. Mostly discussing the reconstruction of the Demon World and changes on the surface.
"Well, we'll head back now! Send our regards to everyone!"
"I'll contact you immediately if there's anything to report, Lord Jin. Please take care."
Silkiya opened a dimensional gate. As the comrades from the Demon World disappeared, the world seemed suddenly quiet.
"We've gained a lot, Jin."
"Yes, Syris. But no matter how much we prepare, it won't be enough for the final battle."
Both wore a bittersweet expression.
"...That's true. When the last war with Zipple begins, many will die. Even among our comrades, there could be casualties."
A reality too painful to imagine or speak of, but it was the truth.
"We will prevent that from happening."

"Of course, we'll do our best. To ensure our loved ones aren't hurt or killed, we'll fight fiercely. But lately... I feel strange. I want to talk to you about unnecessary things. I guess it means I've been relying on you a lot without realizing it."
"Feel free to talk about anything, Syris. And probably I have relied on you and the Ice Castle far more than you on me."
Syris met Jin's eyes. Then, shrugging her shoulders.
"What are you to me, Jin Runcandel? I've only recently been able to resolve that question. Just yesterday, in fact."
